title: My Husband Thinks the Government Isn’t Real
summary: Call-in finance show: a wife whose husband stopped paying taxes, mortgage and loans on sovereign-citizen grounds faces huge IRS debt and foreclosure.

assertions.quote: you're both going to be in prison if you keep this up

verdicts.note: Lenders foreclose and repossess on default regardless of pseudolegal notices, which courts disregard.
After the lender refused the redemption bill of exchange, it found the borrowers in default and foreclosed; this is one case.
Parlee is a case where OPCA mortgage defences ended in loss of the home; a single example.
In 2014 one Alberta court had six Edmonton-area files where OPCA concepts were unsuccessfully raised against foreclosure or eviction.
Paid advisers who say mortgages are invalid have clients who sometimes end up losing their home.
